entities.summary: Kate Ruth "Katie" Allen is an Australian field hockey player. She was a member of the Australia women's national field hockey team that won gold medals at Commonwealth Games, Olympic Games and World Cup in the late 1990s and early 2000s. She is a past FIH World Player of the Year. Katie Allen was a athletes & competitors from Adelaide (b. 1974-02-28, Adelaide). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
